title: Validate the resolved scorer payload that a job will run, not only the caller's inline payload
answers: stored scorer bypasses payload validation on invoke
genai evaluate runs a registered scorer version that was never checked
scorer registered before a security check still runs from the store
body:
Invariant: Scorer payload checks must run on the final serialized scorer that a job or reconstruction will use, after any server-side lookup of a registered scorer and before run or job creation.
Enforced in: mlflow/server/handlers.py:_invoke_genai_evaluate_handler (loop over serialized_scorers after registered versions are substituted, before the run is created) and mlflow/server/handlers.py:_invoke_scorer_handler (re-validates after tracking_store.get_scorer replaces serialized_scorer).
What breaks if skipped: Rows written before a check existed, or caller-chosen scorer_name/scorer_version, reach Scorer.model_validate and the job while the inline payload was the only thing validated.
Constraints: Validating only the request body misses stored rows. Keep the validation ahead of create_run and submit_job so a rejected request leaves no run and no job.
applies: Any handler that resolves a registered scorer or scorer version by name before deserializing or running it.
says: Evaluation jobs run an invalid registered scorer that bypasses safety checks on execution.
Failed evaluation runs still appear in the experiment dashboard when scorer validation fails.
Reject invalid saved evaluators before launching background jobs to avoid creating empty experiment runs.
Ensure model evaluation validates stored scorer versions retrieved from the registry before running.
Older registered evaluators bypass security checks when invoked through the generative evaluation feature.
search: Handlers that resolve registered scorers or scorer versions by name must validate the final serialized scorer payload using _validate_serialized_scorer_payload after server-side lookup and before run or job creation. This is enforced in mlflow/server/handlers.py in _invoke_genai_evaluate_handler across substituted serialized_scorers and in _invoke_scorer_handler after tracking_store.get_scorer replaces serialized_scorer. Validating only caller request bodies allows legacy or unvalidated stored rows to reach Scorer.model_validate. Validation must precede create_run and submit_job so rejected requests produce no orphaned runs or jobs.
